title: Data-efficient crack quantification in lithium-ion cathodes using foundation model transfer
abstract: arXiv:2608.27162v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Battery lifetime is central to sustainable electrification, yet the particle cracking that drives lithium-ion cathode aging is hard to measure: quantitative microscopy of this degradation is bottlenecked by annotation, because each destructive electron-microscopy cross-section spans hundreds of megapixels and pixel-level expert labelling requires hours per image. We show that a frozen self-supervised vision-transformer encoder, combined with a lightweight trainable decoder and iterative model-assisted annotation, turns this sparse labelling budget into population-scale degradation measurements. Applied to three 120-megapixel NMC cathode cross-sections representing initial, cycled-aged and calendar-aged states, the framework distinguishes intragranular cracks from early- and late-stage intergranular cracks and yields per-particle distributions of crack width, tortuosity and area fraction. Late intergranular crack coverage reaches 4.6% i

translated_title: 基于基础模型迁移的高效锂离子正极裂纹量化方法
translated_abstract: 电池寿命对可持续电气化至关重要，然而驱动锂离子正极老化的颗粒裂纹难以测量：这种退化的定量显微镜分析受限于标注工作，因为每张破坏性电子显微镜截面图像覆盖数亿像素，而像素级专家标注每张图像需要数小时。我们证明，一个冻结的自监督视觉变换器编码器，结合轻量级可训练解码器和迭代式模型辅助标注，能将这种稀疏的标注预算转化为群体规模的退化测量。将该框架应用于三张代表初始、循环老化和日历老化状态的1.2亿像素NMC正极截面，它能够区分晶内裂纹与早期和晚期晶间裂纹，并生成每个颗粒的裂纹宽度、曲折度和面积分数分布。晚期晶间裂纹覆盖率可达4.6%。
tldr: 本文提出一种利用冻结的自监督视觉变换器与轻量级解码器结合迭代标注的方法，仅需少量标注即可高效量化锂离子正极中的多种裂纹类型及其分布特征。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a method combining a frozen self-supervised vision transformer with a lightweight decoder and iterative annotation, enabling efficient quantification of various crack types and distributions in lithium-ion cathodes with minimal labeling effort.
